headings.description: Elegant, cinematic serif for premium restaurant feel. Use for all H1, H2, H3.

body.description: Clean, highly readable modern sans-serif to contrast the classic headings.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Mobile-first responsive grids.
layouts.hero: Full-screen cinematic hero (min-h-screen). Overlay: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0908] via-[#0A0908]/40 to-black/20 to preserve image visibility while allowing text to pop. Keep text aligned left or center with high contrast.
layouts.navbar: Crystal Glass pattern: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0908]/70 border-b border-white/10. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for navbar.
layouts.about_section: Split-screen layout (grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2). Text on one side with generous leading, image on the other with sharp or 4px radius edges.
layouts.bento_grid: For Experience section. Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Asymmetric span logic. No excessive border radius (max rounded-sm).
layouts.gallery: Masonry layout (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6). Images break the grid vertically.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm). 1px solid border in gold (#D4AF37) for outlined buttons, solid gold background (#D4AF37) with dark text for primary CTAs. Add hover transitions: bg-white text-black or scale up slightly.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces for Experience/Reviews. 1px subtle border (border-white/10). Background #171513. Soft ambient glow if needed, no heavy drop shadows.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Dark background (bg-transparent or bg-[#171513]), border-white/20, text-white, focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37].
components.menu: List layout with generous vertical padding per item. Category filters as horizontal scrollable pills. Dotted leader line between item name and price, or right-aligned prices.
components.modals: Lightbox for gallery and detailed view for signature dishes. Glassmorphism overlay.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It adds a premium feel.
motion.reveals: Use Framer Motion for staggered fade-up reveals on text and images as they enter viewport.
motion.hover: Image scale-up (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden containers. Slow transitions (duration-500).

hero.description: Dark luxury restaurant interior for hero background

gallery.description: Cozy restaurant interior with wine glasses

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page hybrid fullstack app matching the described sections.
Hero Section: Full-screen, title 'AYANCHIN DOWNTOWN — Modern Mongolian Dining in the Heart of Ulaanbaatar', 3 buttons, info row (4.2★ · 133 Reviews · Open Until 12 AM).
Navbar: Sticky glass navbar. Links: Home, Our Story, Menu, Gallery, Reviews, Location, Contact, plus Reserve a Table CTA.
About Section: Split-screen titled 'A Taste of Mongolia, Reimagined'.
Signature Dishes: Showcase 'Mong Gyu Steak with Risotto', 'Bone Marrow', 'Khuushuur', 'Kneecap Soup', 'Caesar Salad' with image cards.
Menu: Interactive filterable menu (All, Mongolian, Steak & Grill, Soups, Salads, Appetizers, Main Courses, Desserts, Drinks).
Experience Section: 'More Than a Meal' bento layout with cards for Authentic, Contemporary, Downtown, Late Evening.
Gallery: Masonry layout with a lightbox click-to-view feature.
Reviews: Display 4.2/5, 133 reviews in an elegant carousel or grid.
Reservation Form: Use Shadcn Form/Input components (name, phone, email, date, time, guests, special request) with validation.
Location: Embed a static map or map iframe pointing to Ulaanbaatar, include address details.
Mobile: Ensure a sticky bottom CTA for 'Reserve a Table' on mobile devices.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Text on images must have sufficient gradient overlay or drop shadow.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus states, typically focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0908].
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons and empty links.

icons.style: Minimalist, thin stroke, matching the elegant serif aesthetic.
